messages:
alex_chen: heads-up — hit a weird namespace clash when I tried adding the ruby sampleapp gem into our Rails app. app already has a Redwood module and loading the gem causes `uninitialized constant Redwood::Client` at boot.

alex_chen: stack trace snippet:```
LoadError: cannot load such file -- redwood
from /app/vendor/bundle/ruby/3.1.0/gems/redwood-0.1.0/lib/redwood.rb:3:in `require'
from /app/config/initializers/redwood.rb:5:in `'<main>'
```

maria_g: ouch. is the gem name literally `redwood`? that will collide with any top-level Redwood constant.

alex_chen: yup, gemspec has name: "redwood" and lib/redwood.rb defines module Redwood; sampleapp adds Redwood::Client. our app uses Redwood::FeatureFlag elsewhere so it's clobbering.

jin-ops: quick workaround: in your Gemfile point at the sampleapp by path and require a different file name, e.g.:```
gem 'redwood', path: '../sampleapp', require: 'redwood_sampleapp'
```then in your app use RedwoodSampleapp::Client or explicit require to avoid autoloading the top-level module.

maria_g: long term, we should avoid publishing gems with such a generic top-level namespace. could we namespace the gem under `redwood_inference` or `redwood_sampleapp`? small breaking change but safer.

alex_chen: i'm down to open a tiny PR on the sampleapp repo to rename the main require file to `redwood_sampleapp.rb` and update the gemspec/README. will that be acceptable on the public samples?

devex-bot: FYI docs: https://docs.redwood.com/dev/sdks/ruby#naming-and-requires (internal note: include guidance for gem require names and collision avoidance) :link: .

jin-ops: sounds good. if you do a PR, include a migration note in README and a one-line changelog. keep the gem name in rubygems if you want but expose a different require path to avoid overriding Redwood.

maria_g: also add a short snippet in quickstart showing `require 'redwood_sampleapp'` and example `RedwoodSampleapp::Client.new(token: ENV['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])`. should reduce confusion for integrators.

alex_chen: will do. opening PR now, thanks. :thumbsup:

alex_chen: (follow-up) PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sampleapp/pull/42 — changes lib/redwood.rb -> lib/redwood_sampleapp.rb, updates gemspec and README. please review when you have a sec.

maria_g: nice, thanks. quick review incoming. :eyes:

jin-ops: approve once CI passes. also add a short note in devex checklist about avoiding top-level module names for sample gems.

alex_chen: good call, i'll add that to the PR description.

devex-bot: reminder: add CHANGELOG entry and run `bundle exec rake build` to ensure gem builds locally.

alex_chen: done, thanks everyone.
